QuestInfo.name: Looking for a House
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p426# of #m10003007# has something more to say about houses.
QuestInfo.1: #p426# of #m10003007# gruffly told me that if I wanted a house, I should go see #b#p427##k. I should be able to find #p427# in the center of #m10003000#.
QuestInfo.2: It seems I can buy a house from #p427# of #m10003000#. I'll have to remember that.

0.0: But how do you get such a nice place, you ask? Heh, you're an impatient one, aren't you? #b#p427##k could answer that faster than I can. Want to go meet her?

yes.0: Good! Head out of #m10003007# and keep going west, and you'll run into #b#p427##k soon enough.
yes.1: Well, that's all I can tell you. If you've got more questions, come ask me anytime. I also sell all kinds of house-related stuff here at #m10003007#, so swing by often.

no.0: Looks like you're busy right now. But when you've got time, go meet her, got it?

1.0: Hello. I'm showing houses to everyone who's recently become a resident of #m10003000#. Looks like you've already met #p426#... Am I right? Good, that'll save us some time.
1.1: Residents of #m10003000# whose Citizenship Grade is #rVisitor#k or higher can purchase a house through me. We've priced them especially low so as many people as possible can own one. There's no need to worry about the cost.
1.2: Still, you shouldn't buy a house without seeing it first. You can tour the house I'm offering, so take a good look around and buy it if you like it.
1.3: Once you buy a house, a portal will appear at the house entrance behind me, and you can enter #h0#'s house through it anytime. You can manage and decorate your home with the #r#p433##k inside, so be sure to check it out.
1.4: Lastly, you can use the #r#p432##k in front of your house to visit your neighbors' houses. Just keep in mind that you can only enter houses that allow visitors.
1.5: That was a long explanation. Now, it's your turn to get a house! If you'd like to buy one or want to know more, just talk to me anytime.

npc.0: If you want to buy a house, go see #b#p427##k in the center of #m10003000#.
